image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, earthy surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow patches and spots. Its head is broad, and its short limbs are visible, particularly the front left limb which shows distinct digits. The skin appears moist and reflective.
